name: HumanML3D
summary: 基于 AMASS 与 HumanAct12 的三维人体运动和文本描述数据，提供标准预处理与运动表示。
summaryEn: Text-paired 3D human motion derived from AMASS and HumanAct12 with standard preprocessing and motion representations.
organizationsZh: 阿尔伯塔大学及合作者
license: Code: MIT; AMASS, HumanAct12 and body-model terms also apply
licenseZh: 代码为 MIT；另适用 AMASS、HumanAct12 和人体模型条款
access: Official reconstruction scripts; obtain source data and body models separately
accessZh: 官方重建脚本；需另行获取原始数据和人体模型
verdict: 文本条件三维运动序列
wmNote: 连续关节和根运动支持生成与预测；源数据与 AMASS 重叠，不能视为独立采集样本。
wmNoteEn: Joint and root sequences support generation and prediction; AMASS overlap means this is not independently captured data.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - EricGuo5513/HumanML3D: HumanML3D: A large and diverse 3d human motion-language dataset. · GitHub
evidence.statement: Text annotations pair with 20-fps 3D motion clips derived from AMASS/HumanAct12; not independent motion acquisition.
